name: The Verdant Labyrinth Cabinet
descriptions: You stand before a glowing wooden pedestal, its surfaces etched with intricate floral patterns that catch the flickering neon ambiance of the room. You reach out to touch the joystick, feeling the worn, smooth plastic that has seen decades of eager hands.

As the screen hums to life, a lush, pixelated world of ivy and stone paths unfurls before you. The soft click-clack of the buttons echoes in the dim light as you begin your journey through the digital greenery.

toggle_state.on_description: The cabinet screen glows bright, displaying a lush pixelated maze of ivy and stone paths.
toggle_state.off_description: The cabinet sits dark and silent, its glass screen reflective in the dim light.
toggle_state.on_sequence: You flip the power switch, and the arcade cabinet hums to life as a soft neon glow illuminates the floral etchings on the frame and the pixelated maze fills the CRT screen.
toggle_state.off_sequence: You power down the cabinet, watching the screen collapse into a tiny white dot before fading into complete darkness as the gentle electronic hum ceases.

name: Void-Runner Cabinet
descriptions: You stand before a towering monolith of scuffed wood and brushed chrome. The glass screen hums with a faint, electric vibration, casting a flickering violet glow across your knuckles.
Beneath the joystick, shadows seem to dance within the pixelated depths. Every movement of the knob sends a jittery signal into a dark labyrinth of stone and torchlight.

toggle_state.on_description: The glass monitor hums with an active violet light, projecting a dark dungeon maze.
toggle_state.off_description: The towering monolith stands inactive, its chrome frame cold and screen pitch black.
toggle_state.on_sequence: You toggle the heavy chrome switch, sending an electric jolt through the cabinet as the glass screen bursts with a flickering violet light and the dark labyrinth boots up.
toggle_state.off_sequence: You cut the power, causing the flickering violet ambiance to vanish instantly as the internal vibration dies down into still silence.

name: Explorers' Ruins Maze
descriptions: A weathered wooden cabinet stands in the dim corner, its laminate peeling to reveal particle board beneath. You press the joystick, and the CRT screen flickers to life with a soft, high-pitched hum. As you navigate the pixelated corridors, the glowing scanlines dance across the cracked glass, illuminating a crumbling labyrinth of stone and moss. Each movement of the lever triggers a rhythmic, 8-bit chime that echoes through the neon-lit gloom.

toggle_state.on_description: The scanlines on the CRT screen glow steadily, rendering a crumbling stone labyrinth.
toggle_state.off_description: The weathered wooden cabinet rests quietly with a cold, blank screen.
toggle_state.on_sequence: You press the power button, hearing a high-pitched hum as scanlines rapidly trace across the glass to reveal the pixelated ruins.
toggle_state.off_sequence: You shut off the unit, killing the high-pitched monitor buzz as the glowing green scanlines dissolve into the dark glass.

name: Neon Pastoral Mountain Maze
descriptions: You stand before a towering cabinet, its side panels vibrating with the hum of high-voltage electricity. A soft, magenta glow spills from the screen, casting long, flickering shadows across the linoleum floor.

The control joystick feels smooth and worn from countless frenzied movements, while the colorful buttons click with a satisfying, mechanical snap. As you tilt the controls, you guide a glowing cursor through a stylized landscape of pixelated peaks and valleys.
The scent of ozone and warm electronics wafts from the ventilation slats, pulling you deeper into the digitized wilderness.

toggle_state.on_description: A vibrant magenta glow bathes the area as the monitor projects stylized pixelated peaks.
toggle_state.off_description: The towering cabinet stands dormant, its ventilation fans quiet and screen unlit.
toggle_state.on_sequence: You turn on the cabinet, feeling a brief static discharge as a deep magenta light floods the display and the cooling fans spin up with a warm scent of ozone.
toggle_state.off_sequence: You flick the breaker switch off, immediately extinguishing the vivid magenta aura and letting the cabinet power down into a silent chill.

name: The Biosphere-09 Simulation Cabinet
descriptions: You stand before a gleaming metallic cabinet, its surface detailed with circuit patterns and glass panels. A worn control interface features a tactile grid layout alongside rows of physical toggle switches and biological status labels.
A glass CRT monitor sits embedded in the housing, directly connected to an internal hardware matrix designed for hosting tick-based artificial life environments.

toggle_state.on_description: The CRT display hums brightly, rendering an active, tick-based grid of artificial organisms interacting in real time.
toggle_state.off_description: The metallic cabinet sits quiet and dormant, its grid display completely black.
toggle_state.on_sequence: You power on the cabinet, feeling a mild static charge as the CRT monitor crackles to life, revealing an evolving ALIFE matrix governed by steady clock ticks.
toggle_state.off_sequence: You hit the main power toggle, freezing the simulated ecosystem in place before the grid display fades out with a soft electronic whine.
